name: PeerToPeerFundraisingHub
tagline: Teams, fundraisers, leaderboards, badges and offline gifts – run your walk, run or challenge campaign in one app.
description: A complete peer-to-peer fundraising app for nonprofits in one PCF control: teams and individual fundraisers with goals and progress, live individual and team leaderboards with a podium, drag-and-drop team moves with captain and team-size rules, milestones and badges with one-click awarding and congratulation messages, and an offline donation desk with second-person verification, cash receipt rules, matching-gift checks and duplicate detection. Works in canvas apps, model-driven apps and Power Pages, with built-in demo data.
features: Online + verified offline totals per fundraiser, team and campaign
Team size limit, closed teams and one captain per team
Configurable milestones and 12 badges with Award and congratulation text
Cash receipt rule, matching-gift employer rule, duplicate detection
Inactivity nudges with prepared message text
Activity tracking (km, miles, steps…) with Challenge complete badge
Stretch goals, undo, CSV export, keyboard shortcuts
Power Fx outputs and OnSelect / OnChange / OnCreate / OnSave / OnAction / OnStatusChange events
